decisions.statement: An update that changed the layout has a codec of its own.
An update that changed no layout is read by the codec of the update it matches.
Every past update stays readable and only the newest update is written.
The first byte says the build is a character and the next byte says which update wrote the build.
A build whose first two bytes are not recognised is read as nothing.
The writer and the reader of one update take the bits in the one order.
Every update a character or companion codec reads is round-tripped by a test.
Every codec kept for a character or a companion build both writes and reads.

definition: packing a character build into text and reading one back at whichever update wrote it
